Reviso por qué se bota el interruptor, cambio contactos y apagadores, instalo lámparas, ventiladores y paneles, y ordeno cableado viejo. I find out why a breaker keeps tripping, replace outlets and switches, install light fixtures, ceiling fans and panels, and tidy old wiring. I come first to look, explain what I found and what it costs before I start. I bring basic materials; if something else is needed, we buy it with your approval.

Si administras departamentos de renta, puedo hacer revisiones periódicas. Me escribes qué pasa y la zona, y te propongo un horario.
demos.bioEn: I am a plumber in Tampa. I handle leaks, clogged drains, water heaters and bathroom fixture swaps in houses, apartments and vacation rentals. Many customers call me because they prefer a woman coming into their home. I arrive, look, tell you what is going on and what it costs, and work with your approval. If you manage rental units, I can do regular check-ups. Message me what is happening and your area, and I will propose a time.
